Hi Samir / Lina —

Thanks again for signing — really excited to get OrchidTech onto Redwood Dedicated. Attached is a concise stepwise implementation map that embeds the evaluation plan we agreed on during the close. High-level summary below and action items at the end.

Attachment: OrchidTech_MAP_v1.pdf (2 pages — MAP + acceptance criteria)

Summary (TL;DR):
- Week 0 (this week): Provisioning + account kick-off; Redwood to provide baseline perf profile and sandbox access.
- Week 1–2: Canary deployment (10% production traffic) for two feature flags; performance and quality evals run daily.
- Week 3: Migration ramp to 50% with staged fallback windows; operator training sessions + runbook handoff.
- Week 4: Full cutover and 30-day observation window; delivery of final acceptance pack for invoicing.

Evaluation plan excerpts:
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 220ms for chat endpoints — tracked per route in Console.
- Cost/per-token targets: Within 15% of estimate when batching enabled.
- Quality criteria: Prompt set A - top-1 exact-match >= 86%; regression tests auto-run nightly.
- Rollback criteria: any sustained p95 violation > 30% over SLO for 2 hours OR quality regression > 6 points across primary prompt set.

Immediate asks for OrchidTech:
1) Confirm preferred kickoff window (Tue 8/5 or Wed 8/6) for the provisioning call.
2) Share a list of 3–5 prompts/scenarios for the initial evaluation set (or we can reuse the set from the POA).
3) Please loop in procurement if there are any remaining PO terms to close before the provision.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marissa will share the canary runbook and training calendar.
- Priyom will provide the initial cluster sizing and migration checklist.

Thanks — I’ll be on the provisioning call to align rollout windows.

—
Dylan Brooks

Hi team —

Jumping in from Solutions/CS side to confirm operational details and the training cadence. Answers inline:

Samir — great Qs.
1) Canary fallback: yes — our smart routing policy will fail over to a hosted-compatible model variant in a different capacity tier if p95 or error-rate gates trip. That failover is automatic but we’ll test it in a controlled fashion during the canary window. We’ll document the exact trigger thresholds in the runbook.

2) Runbook sign-off: please use the following contact for SOW:
   - Marissa Cole, Sr. Solutions Engineer — marissa_cole@redwood.com

Canary runbook & training plan (high level):
- Day 0 (canary start): Confirm telemetry, sampling, and tracing hooks; smoke tests (10 scenarios).
- Days 1–3: Daily evaluation reports (latency, token-cost, prompt set pass rate). If green, increase to 50% on Day 7.
- Training: two 90-minute operator sessions (recorded) — one for runbook ops, one for incident response and rollback playbook.

I’ve attached a condensed runbook checklist (we’ll share the full workbook during the kickoff).

Attachment: migration_runbook_v1.xlsx (checklist + SLO test matrix)

Operational asks for OrchidTech before kickoff:
- Confirm a technical point-of-contact for the operator sessions.
- Provide temporary API tokens for the sandbox (we will rotate them after provisioning).

We’ll also include a quick canary rehearsal during the provisioning call so everyone sees the routing/fallback in action.

—

Samir —

Quick readout from infra/engineering on cluster sizing and migration checklist. High-level:
- Initial Dedicated pool: 2x A100-equivalent nodes, configured for low-latency chat workloads with kv-cache enabled. This supports baseline 200 qps with room for 2x burst.
- Canary routing: request sampling (10%), continuous batching up to 16 tokens, and prefix caching for common prompts.
- Migration checklist highlights (short):
   * Pre-provision: verify network egress rules and KMS integration (bring-your-own-key — if you want).
   * Provision: spin up nodes in us-west-2, ensure model variant compatibility (we’ll handle quantization profile selection).
   * Canary: enable telemetry and automated alerts to the Redwood Console and your Ops channel.
   * Cutover: staged DNS switch + throttled ramp over 3 hours.

I’ve attached the migration runbook with the checklist and acceptance test commands. Feel free to flag anything you’d like added.

Attachment: migration_runbook_v1.xlsx

If Wed 8/6 09:30 PT is confirmed I’ll be on the provisioning call to kick the provisioning steps off immediately.

—
